limitations: Supervisor creates/reaps backend trees; fixture preparation, GDB/relay, progress/notification and scheduling remain in the harness.
Windows Job Object is resource ownership, not a security sandbox.
Supervisor death is measured; host-harness death while supervisors survive is not newly validated.
Native terminal report is absent after supervisor death; actual child exit was checked independently.
Initial guarded run predates owner-injection helper additions; final faults and recovery share recorded input hashes.
No engine/firmware update, IDE matrix rerun or capability expansion.
